payload.body_content:
J,

I pulled the live Agent-in-Body repo. The clean integration is real:
A:iB proposes and transports intent; EMILIA stays the independent
admission boundary.

Two public details should change. The demo currently changes the lamp
state directly after parsing text. It should stop at a proposed action
unless a separate Gate admission is supplied. The GRACE card says
"verifiable proof-of-curtailment." I would use "evidence-bound
curtailment admission and reconciliation," since neither a command nor
a receipt proves the physical effect.

Also keep the A:iB persona, mailbox transport signer, and
institutionally authorized principal separate. One key should not
silently become all three.

Then the story is precise: A:iB proposes the exact action,
emilia-mailbox carries it, EMILIA admits or refuses it, and the
actuator reports executed, refused, or indeterminate.

Your mailbox boundary already says this well:
https://github.com/jdieselny/emilia-mailbox/blob/main/docs/EMILIA_ACCEPTANCE_BOUNDARY.md

Best,
Iman
